scenarios.title: Move a booking: the whole family (parent + top-up) moves together, or nobody does; a full target and a past-cutoff target are both refused

checks.description: A: paid family of 3 built (parent 2 + top-up 1)
A: the source holds all 3 seats before the move
A: move succeeded
A: the WHOLE family moved (2 rows, 3 seats)
A: the move names BOTH times (old → new)
A: parent repointed to the new session, re-dated, and stamped
A: the top-up child rode along (same new session, stamped)
A: the source released all 3 seats
A: the target claimed all 3 seats
B: paid family of 3 built on a second session
B: the move was REFUSED (no room for the whole family)
B: the family did NOT move (still on the source, never stamped)
B: the source is untouched (still 3 seats)
B: the full target is untouched (still 4 seats)
C: a move into a slot past its own cutoff is REFUSED
C: the family still did NOT move
C: the past-cutoff target claimed nobody

scenarios.note: The move is one atomic RPC: it locks the family and both sessions, re-checks capacity and the cutoff under lock, then claims the target and releases the source — or raises and rolls the whole thing back, leaving the source exactly as it was.
